front: Name the five types of waste in the syllabus.
back: Domestic, industrial, agricultural, medical and electronic.
Reduce, reuse, recycle, recover, then dispose safely as a last resort.

front: Give three problems of poor waste disposal.
back: Disease (flies, rats, cholera), pollution from burning and dumping, flooding from blocked drains (also harm to animals, injury).

front: What does EMA do in waste management?
back: Sets standards, licenses waste sites, inspects, educates and fines offenders; bans some polluting products.

front: Why is composting well suited to Zimbabwe?
back: Much household waste is organic; composting is cheap and produces fertiliser for gardens.
